formula: purchase*0.30 + subscription*0.25 + retention*0.15 + pain*0.15 + evergreen*0.10 + novelty*0.05 - competition*0.10
note: Virality is tracked but does not directly increase priorityScore.

opportunities.pain: I understand English content but freeze when I need to speak
opportunities.buyerMotivation: Wants active speaking confidence, not passive recognition of words.
opportunities.productBridge: Phraseman trains ready-to-use phrases for real speaking moments.

opportunities.pain: I feel embarrassed speaking English out loud
opportunities.buyerMotivation: Wants private practice before risking mistakes with real people.
opportunities.productBridge: Phraseman gives low-pressure phrase rehearsal before real conversations.

opportunities.pain: I have studied English for years but still feel stuck
opportunities.buyerMotivation: Wants a visible breakthrough after long, demoralizing effort.
opportunities.productBridge: Phraseman turns knowledge into small usable speaking actions instead of another passive lesson streak.

opportunities.pain: I keep forgetting the English I learn
opportunities.buyerMotivation: Wants a system that makes phrases stick and return at the right time.
opportunities.productBridge: Phraseman uses repeated phrase practice and recall to make useful English stay usable.

opportunities.pain: I need English for work calls and messages
opportunities.buyerMotivation: Has a practical deadline and direct economic reason to improve.
opportunities.productBridge: Phraseman trains phrase patterns that transfer into work calls, chats, and meetings.
